notes: Line-item templates. 'per' says how the quantity is derived: surface_area (whole surface, painted to the nearest break so the repair does not show), region_area_margin (region bounding box grown by margin_m on every side), wall_length_x_height (a horizontal band along the whole wall), length (crack length), each (one per trigger). Items are de-duplicated per surface (one repaint per wall).

items.text: stain-block primer + 2 coats paint, whole wall
items.why: water stains bleed through ordinary paint; repaint to the corners so the patch does not show
same as walls; ceilings are repainted whole

items.text: cut out and replace ceiling board (stain + 0.3 m margin), if moisture survey confirms wet
items.why: wet board loses strength and the margin covers wetness beyond the visible edge

items.text: leak investigation + moisture mapping above the ceiling
items.why: fix the source before the finish

items.text: flood cut: remove and replace drywall to 0.6 m along the wall, dry cavity
items.why: wicking wets the board and cavity above the visible line; standard 2 ft cut

items.text: inspect, water-test and reseal window perimeter
rake out, tape and fill crack, sand
prime + paint wall after crack repair

items.why: diagonal cracks from opening corners can indicate movement

items.text: inspection hole / borescope of the cavity behind the stain for mould
